title: New Zealand perils
text:
New Zealand perils

The following table lists the perils and peril codes that 
Touchstone
 supports for New Zealand.

| Import peril code | Peril |
| --- | --- |
| PAL | All licensed perils |
| PEA | All earthquake perils |
| PES | Earthquake shake only |
| PFF | Fire following only |
| PLQ | Liquefaction |
| PLS | Landslide |
| PTS | Tsunami |
